Authentication

\n

Every request to the Godzilla API is authenticated with a bearer API key.

\n\n

Getting an API key

\n

Generate one from your workspace settings. Keys are scoped to a single workspace and inherit the standard rate limit described in Rate limits & errors.

\n\n

Using the key

\n{{ds:component/code-block|filename=terminal|language=bash|code=curl https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v2/pipelines \\\n -H \"Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY\"}}\n\n{{ds:component/alert|variant=danger|title=Never expose a key client-side|body_html=

API keys carry full workspace access. Keep them server-side only — never embed one in a mobile app, browser bundle, or public repository.

}}\n\n

Verifying webhook requests

\n

Incoming webhook deliveries are authenticated differently: by a signed X-Godzilla-Signature header rather than your API key.

input.body:
Authentication

Every request to the Godzilla API is authenticated with a bearer API key.

Getting an API key

Generate one from your workspace settings. Keys are scoped to a single workspace and inherit the standard rate limit described in Rate limits & errors.

Using the key

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=terminal|language=bash|code=curl https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v2/pipelines \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY"}} {{ds:component/code-block|filename=main.go|language=go|code=package main import ( "context" "log" "os" "github.com/godzilla/sdk-go" ) func main() { client := sdk.NewClient( sdk.WithAPIKey(os.Getenv("GODZILLA_API_KEY")), ) pipelines, err := client.ListPipelines(context.Background()) if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) } for _, p := range pipelines { log.Printf("Pipeline: %s (%s) ", p.Name, p.ID) } }}} {{ds:component/alert|variant=danger|title=Never expose a key client-side|body_html=

API keys carry full workspace access. Keep them server-side only — never embed one in a mobile app, browser bundle, or public repository.

}}

Verifying webhook requests

Incoming webhook deliveries are authenticated differently: by a signed X-Godzilla-Signature header rather than your API key.

Building your first pipeline

This guide walks through creating a pipeline end to end: a source connector, a destination connector, and the pipeline that ties them together.

{{ds:component/alert|variant=info|title=Before you start|body_html=

You'll need an API key. See Authentication in Getting Started if you don't have one yet.

}}

1. Create a source connector

We'll pull orders from Postgres. See Connectors for the full catalog of types.

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=create-source.sh|language=bash|code=curl -X POST https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v2/connectors \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY" \ -d '{"type":"postgres","direction":"source","config":{"connection_string":"postgres://..."}}'}} {{ds:component/code-block|filename=main.go|language=go|code=package main import ( "context" "log" "os" "github.com/godzilla/sdk-go" ) func main() { client := sdk.NewClient( sdk.WithAPIKey(os.Getenv("GODZILLA_API_KEY")), ) connector, err := client.CreateConnector(context.Background(), &sdk.CreateConnectorRequest{ Type: "postgres", Direction: "source", Config: map[string]interface(){ "connection_string": "postgres://...", }, }) if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) } log.Printf("Created source connector: %s ", connector.ID) }}}

2. Create a destination connector

We'll write to Snowflake.

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=create-destination.sh|language=bash|code=curl -X POST https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v2/connectors \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY" \ -d '{"type":"snowflake","direction":"destination","config":{"account":"..."}}'}} {{ds:component/code-block|filename=main.go|language=go|code=package main import ( "context" "log" "os" "github.com/godzilla/sdk-go" ) func main() { client := sdk.NewClient( sdk.WithAPIKey(os.Getenv("GODZILLA_API_KEY")), ) connector, err := client.CreateConnector(context.Background(), &sdk.CreateConnectorRequest{ Type: "snowflake", Direction: "destination", Config: map[string]interface(){ "account": "...", }, }) if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) } log.Printf("Created destination connector: %s ", connector.ID) }}}

3. Create the pipeline

Full request/response details are in the Pipelines endpoint reference.

{{ds:component/code-block|filename=create-pipeline.sh|language=bash|code=curl -X POST https://api.godzilladocs.dev/v2/pipelines \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $GODZILLA_API_KEY" \ -d '{"name":"ingest-orders","source_connector_id":"conn_pg_orders","destination_connector_id":"conn_snowflake_dw"}'}} {{ds:component/code-block|filename=main.go|language=go|code=package main import ( "context" "log" "os" "github.com/godzilla/sdk-go" ) func main() { client := sdk.NewClient( sdk.WithAPIKey(os.Getenv("GODZILLA_API_KEY")), ) pipeline, err := client.CreatePipeline(context.Background(), &sdk.CreatePipelineRequest{ Name: "ingest-orders", SourceConnectorID: "conn_pg_orders", DestinationConnectorID: "conn_snowflake_dw", }) if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) } log.Printf("Created pipeline: %s ", pipeline.ID) }}}

The pipeline starts in draft state. Activate it once you're ready to start processing events.

Next steps

Now that events are flowing, read Handling errors & retries to see what happens when a write fails, or Monitoring & alerts to watch it run.
